caption:
Your Schengen visa covers 29 countries. Europe has more than 29 countries.

The UK is not in Schengen. Neither is Ireland. A Schengen visa does not admit you to either.

Within the 29, you move freely once approved — and it genuinely does not matter which embassy issued it. What matters is that you applied to the right one.

slides.headline: SCHENGEN IS NOT EUROPE.
slides.note: Your visa covers 29 countries. Europe has considerably more than 29 countries.

slides.answer: THE UK IS NOT IN SCHENGEN.
slides.body: Neither is Ireland. A Schengen visa does not admit you to either — they run separate systems with separate applications.
slides.note: People book multi-country trips assuming one visa covers the continent. It does not.

slides.headline: YOUR SCHENGEN VISA ACTUALLY DOES
items: Lets you move freely between them once approved
Works regardless of which embassy issued it
Does not cover the UK, Ireland, or non-Schengen states

slides.headline: THE PLANNING MISTAKE
slides.never: Build an itinerary that includes London or Dublin on a Schengen visa and assume you will be admitted. You will not be, and the trip breaks mid-route.
slides.instead: Map the route first, identify which permissions it actually requires, then apply for each properly and in the right order.
